name: The Weather
overview: Scripture reveals that the weather is under God's sovereign control, demonstrating His power and authority over creation from the very beginning, as He created the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1). The weather can serve as a means of blessing or judgment, such as rain sustaining life or destructive hail and dust coming as consequences of disobedience (Deuteronomy 28:24; Joshua 10:11). The psalmist acknowledges God's providential care in nature, looking to the hills for help and recognizing stormy winds and hail as fulfilling His word (Psalms 121:1; 148:8). Thus, the weather testifies to God's active presence and governance in the world.
